source_locator.edition_or_translation: J. M. Ashmand translation from Proclus's Greek paraphrase; 1900 W. Foulsham & Co. new edition
source_locator.short_quote: the planet which precedes is said to apply to that which follows

condition.bodily_conjunction_latitude_condition: actual latitudes must place the transit in the same zodiacal part

normalized_rule: At a source-defined trifling distance, classify the preceding body as applying to the following body; for bodily conjunction, the bodies must transit the same zodiacal part by latitude.
synthesis_notes: This is a source-specific motion/relationship classification, not an astronomical speed calculation or a guaranteed event.
review_notes: The main text does not numerically define 'trifling'. The same-latitude qualification is retained for bodily conjunction; the editorial orb list in footnote 61 is not imported as a settled threshold.
transmission_notes: The main text supplies the application relation, while the numerical orb list appears in an editorial footnote and the proposed meaning of 'precedes' appears in another editorial note. Neither is silently promoted to a Ptolemaic calculation rule.
